# How many washes a day does a self-serve dog wash need to pay for itself?

> Free self-serve and full-service dog wash calculator: tubs, wash price, washes per tub by weekday, weekend and season, water, supplies, labor, build-out and a loan become break-even washes per day, monthly ramp, payback and equity return. Private, runs in your browser.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
